newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen's recent appreciation rapid - BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Yen's recent appreciation rapid - BOJ quoted.

text.p: The yen's recent appreciation has been rapid, Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso quoted Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita as saying on Tuesday.
"We have seen a rapid appreciation by the yen in the foreign exchange market since May," Aso quoted Matsushita as telling cabinet ministers at a meeting on Tuesday morning.

The governor was also quoted as saying that concerns over the outlook for the Japanese financial system have receded recently and that this was reflected in the rise of the yen, Japanese interest rates and stock prices.
